headline: Iran says talks under way on two-day plan to reopen Hormuz
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: Iran says talks under way on two-day plan to reopen Hormuz; Carney widens trade push as U.S. deal stays out of reach; Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike.

top.headline: Iran says talks under way on two-day plan to reopen Hormuz
top.what: Tehran says it is negotiating through Qatar on reopening the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the U.S. meets its conditions, even as tankers keep catching fire near the strait.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Carney widens trade push as U.S. deal stays out of reach
top.what: With a deal on U.S. tariffs still elusive, Prime Minister Mark Carney is stepping up trade talks with other partners, while a reshuffled list of Canadian goods facing 50% U.S. tariffs took effect Friday.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike
top.what: Statistics Canada says the economy was flat in August and probably shrank 0.1% in September, a weak backdrop for the Bank of Canada's first rate increase since 2023.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ontario deficit grows to $16.9 billion; balance pushed to 2029-30
top.what: Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy's fall update raised this year's deficit by more than $3 billion and delayed a balanced budget by a year as the trade war slows growth.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Early vote passes 44 million as midterms enter final weekend
top.what: With Election Day on Tuesday, Democrats lead national polls for the House while Senate control rests on a handful of toss-up races.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: U.S. economy grows 3.4% in third quarter as inflation cools
top.what: The U.S. economy expanded at a 3.4% annual rate from July to September, faster than the spring, while a key inflation gauge eased.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Final count leaves Netanyahu's bloc at 53 seats, short of a majority
top.what: Israel faces weeks of coalition talks after final results gave neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's a 61-seat majority, and Likud claimed the vote was stolen.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Canada and EU launch 'Alliance for the Future' and aim for associate ties
top.what: Carney and EU leaders wrapped a two-day summit in Montreal by starting work on a closer partnership short of full membership, with a goal of defining it by next year.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.
